name: Lang's Old Car Parts, Inc.
old_description: Lang's Old Car Parts is a family owned company with a true passion for the Model T Ford. We have the most complete catalog available on the market, including new and used Model T parts. We also carry a large selection of accessories, books and instructional movies. Ever since our founding over 35 years ago, we have worked hard to provide the best Model T parts with the great customer service and free technical support.
about:
Lang's Old Car Parts, Inc. operates from Baldwinville, Massachusetts, where it was founded more than 35 years ago as a family-owned business built around a passion for the Model T Ford. The company began with family members selling used parts at swap meets before expanding into a dedicated catalog and online operation.

The firm specializes in supplying new, used, and new-old-stock (NOS) parts for the Model T, along with accessories, books, and instructional videos. Its catalog covers hundreds of categories — from engine and transmission components to body, upholstery, and electrical items — and also includes parts for Fordson tractors. The company does not manufacture parts; it sources and stocks inventory for direct sale to customers via phone and an e-commerce site.

Primary customers are Model T owners, restorers, and hobbyists, as well as Fordson tractor enthusiasts. The staff, three-quarters of whom own a Model T themselves, provide free technical support to help buyers identify the correct components for their projects.

The company emphasizes its comprehensive catalog, knowledgeable staff, and free technical assistance as key differentiators, aiming to be the go-to resource for Model T restoration.
